messages:
marta: Heads-up — NovaThera asked to expand SOC2 scope to include eu-west-2 for the upcoming renewal. They want confirmation by EOD Friday. tagging infra & legal. @ryan_security @jamie_legal
ryan_security: Quick Q — do they mean processing+storage in eu-west-2 or just failover? If we need to host data there we may need Private/Dedicated sign-off.
jamie_legal: Need clarity but either way we'll need a small amendment to the DPA + SCCs. Also: will BYOK/BYOK-HSM be requested?
oliver_onboard: I spoke with their CSM earlier — they currently send analytics logs + occasional user attachments. Some attachments include contact info (name/email). I'll update the dataflow diagram but need example payloads.
audit-bot: New evidence request created: EV-4589 — SOC2 scope expansion for NovaThera. Owner: marta. Due: 2026-04-03.
marta: Cool — assigning action items: 1) infra (ryan) confirm region capabilities & encryption; 2) cs (oliver) update dataflow + examples; 3) legal (jamie) draft amendment. I'll compile answers into the spreadsheet: https://tinyurl.com/novathera-soc2
ryan_security: Ran a quick check — our region-config doesn't show a dedicated eu-west-2 tenancy for NovaThera. We can serve from hosted endpoints in eu-west-2 but need explicit customer consent for cross-border processing if they want a global CDN. Suggest we offer a dedicated pool, but that requires 2-3 weeks to provision if they want BYOK.
ryan_security: quick command I ran for the record: ```aws redwood region-config describe --region eu-west-2```
oliver_onboard: I'll update the dataflow diagram by EOD tomorrow. Can someone share sanitized sample payloads (pseudo-ids ok) so I can confirm what counts as PII vs metadata? @marta
jamie_legal: If BYOK is requested, timeline is ~2-3 weeks to scope + legal review. Prefer to start with SCCs + access restriction amendment to avoid delaying renewal. I'll draft language and share a short checklist of docs needed for the amendment.
marta: Thanks. Plan: schedule a 30m sync with NovaThera + legal + infra. Proposing Tue 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and update EV-4589 after the meeting. :calendar:
ryan_security: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short risk summary + list of evidence we can provide (network diagram, key rotation policy, audit logs, retention policy).
oliver_onboard: Also need a recent export showing retention behavior (sanitized). Can someone pull last ingestion export from `s3://redwood-logs/novathera/` and drop a pseudo-only sample in the drive link?
marta: Noted — added that to EV-4589. I'll follow up after the sync with next steps and due dates. Thanks everyone!
